parameters.content:
## OpenSSH integration
Uses the existing SSH alias configured on the n8n host. No n8n SSH credential required.
The Execute Command node must already be enabled by your administrator.
Review Settings: sshHost, repository, project and run ID.

Installed demo is status-only. Use a dedicated Linux host or SLURM controller for analysis; do not run local analysis on a login node.

Supports the implemented 2.1/3.0 routes. Source fingerprint is checked before launch. Stopping n8n does not cancel remote work.
